title: The phone's network allow-list is a hand copy of the adapters' routes, query keys and headers
evidence: Owner ruling 2026-11-27 (R17): the phone's hand-written allow-list stays the authority, not generated. Add a CI test that fails when it drifts from the adapters' routes.
